matching_search_scope.query_purpose: Text RAG evaluation, factuality, calibration and retrieval robustness
matching_search_scope.verification_method: The component returned the matching persisted completed search checkpoint; the local agent did not independently repeat every provider request.

papers.title: FRESCO: Benchmarking and Optimizing Re-rankers for Evolving Semantic Conflict in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.design_change: Separate semantic sufficiency from temporal validity; evaluate explicit/implicit recency queries and static controls under fixed budgets.
papers.interpretation_guard: Newer timestamps alone do not establish relevance or validity. The obsolete-ratio formula was not read and is not claimed as reproduced.

papers.title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
papers.design_change: Separate evidence availability, evidence utilization and joint answer/evidence correctness; add controlled multi-fact, position and context-length diagnostics.
papers.interpretation_guard: The joint metric is a conjunction, not a sum; no universal long-context superiority or new empirical result is inferred.

papers.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
papers.design_change: Include verified equivalent support and report partial required-information coverage separately from complete coverage; stratify similarity, redundancy and hop count.
papers.interpretation_guard: Alternate valid evidence is not automatically wrong; redundant information is not counted repeatedly; cross-domain associations do not establish independent causal effects.

remaining_work: Inspect exact implementation, code and restrictions before claiming reproduction of any complete paper method.
Validate labels and temporal facts, then perform the proposed controlled experiments and uncertainty analysis.
Continue updating the scoped search and checking unindexed sources or later versions; successful freshness checks do not certify the whole field.
